block.label: neutral
block.reason: The accepted minimal patch implements the required negative-score fix by removing the lower bound on the first risk interval, and removes the high interval upper bound as well. The two omitted reference edits only comment an unused level_five_threshold calculation and delete an else/ValueError fallback that ordinary finite numeric scores cannot reach after those kept interval changes. For nonnegative score_sum, the intervals cover the real line; for negative score_sum the first interval ends at score_sum/16 while the high interval starts below it at score_sum/2, so their union also covers the real line. Keeping an unused calculation and an unreachable exception does not leave the named bug unfixed. Nonfinite inputs and unusual numeric types are not part of the stated APK-score contract, and no outcome for them is promoted.
